Quantum 1.18.0 was certified on 2026-08-26. It pins **nucleus v1.13.0**, **quark v1.6.1** and **orbit v1.7.4**, with 5 sibling modules.

A minor release of the suite after Quantum 1.17.1: nucleus goes from v1.12.1 to v1.13.0 (minor), orbit goes from v1.7.3 to v1.7.4 (patch) and quark stays at v1.6.1. 3 sibling modules change version.
